# Cheat-Sheet Index {#sec-cheat-index .unnumbered}

Each content chapter ends with a two-column reference table of the
commands, rules, and terms introduced in that chapter. This appendix
lists what each table covers, part by part, with a reference to the
full table, where the surrounding context explains any term that is
not self-explanatory.

The entries below are read from the chapters' own tables when the
book is built, so the index cannot fall out of step with them.

```{r}
#| label: cheat-index
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Part and chapter order come from the book's manifest; each entry
# lists the first column of that chapter's cheat-sheet table.
manifest <- readLines('_quarto.yml', warn = FALSE)
stop_at <- grep('^\\s*appendices:', manifest)[1]
manifest <- manifest[seq_len(stop_at - 1)]

part_re <- "^\\s*- part: '(.*)'\\s*$"
file_re <- '^\\s+- ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+[.]qmd)\\s*$'

first_cell <- function(row) {
  sub('^\\|\\s*(.*?)\\s*\\|.*$', '\\1', row, perl = TRUE)
}

entry <- function(file) {
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  start <- grep('^## Cheat sheet \\{#sec-cheat-', lines)
  if (length(start) == 0) return(NULL)
  chapter_id <- sub('.*\\{#(sec-[A-Za-z0-9-]+).*', '\\1', lines[1])
  title <- trimws(sub('\\{.*$', '', sub('^# ', '', lines[1])))
  cheat_id <- sub('.*\\{#(sec-cheat-[A-Za-z0-9-]+)\\}.*', '\\1',
                  lines[start])
  rest <- lines[(start + 1):length(lines)]
  rows <- rest[seq_len(which(!grepl('^\\||^\\s*$', rest))[1] - 1)]
  rows <- grep('^\\|', rows, value = TRUE)
  rows <- rows[-(1:2)]
  cells <- unique(first_cell(rows))
  stopifnot(length(cells) > 0)
  paste0(
    '**@', chapter_id, ', ', title, '** (@', cheat_id, '). ',
    paste(cells, collapse = '; '), '.\n\n'
  )
}

for (ln in manifest) {
  if (grepl(part_re, ln)) {
    cat('## ', sub(part_re, '\\1', ln), '\n\n', sep = '')
  } else if (grepl(file_re, ln)) {
    out <- entry(sub(file_re, '\\1', ln))
    if (!is.null(out)) cat(out)
  }
}
```
